paragraphs: On Friday evening, Lily, Mia, and May wrote in the club chat. They talked about the trip to the nature park on Saturday. Ranger Mark was the ranger at the park.

May: Hello, everyone! Are you ready for tomorrow? Mia: Yes, I am so excited about the birds and the lake! Lily: Me too, but what time do we meet at school? May: We meet at the school gate at eight o'clock. Mia: And when does the bus arrive? May: It arrives at a quarter past eight, and it goes through the town. Lily: How long is the trip to the park? May: It takes forty minutes, so we arrive before nine o'clock.

Mia: What do we bring for the day? May: We bring a hat, a bottle of water, and a notebook. Mia: I have a silver bottle, and it is new. Lily: Nice! Who brings the club flag? May: I do, and it is the green flag with the paw print. Mia: Please do not forget the note from your parents. May: It is very important, because Teacher Kim cannot take us without it.

Lily: Oh no, I cannot find my note! Mia: Look somewhere on your desk. Lily: I looked there, and it is not there. May: Please ask your mom, and look in your bag too. Lily: Wait a minute, and I will look again. Lily: I have just found it under my notebook! Mia: Great, now you are ready. Lily: Dad signed it on Monday, and then I forgot it.

May: What do we see in the park tomorrow? Mia: I want to see the birds near the lake. Lily: I want to see the big tortoise in the quiet corner. May: Ranger Mark can show us both of them. Mia: Good night, May and Lily! Lily: Good night, and see you at the gate! May: See you soon!
text.summary: On Friday evening, Lily, Mia, and May write in the club chat before the Saturday trip to the nature park. They talk about the time, the gate, the flag, and the note that Lily cannot find.
